title: The cold two-stream instability
shows: Two cold electron beams at ±1 m/s (total ω_p = 1/s) in a box whose first mode has k·v₀ = (√3/2)·ω_b: the fastest-growing wave, growing at ω_b/2 = 0.354 ω_p.
source: Two-stream dispersion relation: C. K. Birdsall and A. B. Langdon, Plasma Physics via Computer Simulation (1991), §5.10.
